description:
Ask Zearch a question. Zearch searches the web (or reads the page or site you give it), Jev selects the passages that answer it, a writer drafts from those passages only, and Jev checks every paragraph against its cited source before the answer is returned. Unsupported paragraphs are cut; if nothing survives you get the selected source passage (answer_type "excerpt").

Modes and credits: standard (1, a direct answer in seconds), deep (5, a cited report from up to 8 sources), compare (2, a side-by-side comparison), scrape (1, what one public HTTPS page says; needs url), crawl (3, up to five pages of one site; needs url), reverse (10, static analysis of how an app, repo or site works; needs url, runs on a queue and can take minutes). A follow-up with parent_id that needs no new search costs 0.3. Errors are free.

Returns the answer as Markdown with [n] citations, the sources with the exact excerpt Jev read, per-paragraph support scores, and suggested follow-ups.

mode.description: How much research to do. See the tool description for costs.

parent_id.description: Id of a previous run, to ask a follow-up in the same conversation.

url.description: Public HTTPS URL. Required for scrape, crawl and reverse; ignored otherwise.

use_notes.description: Also use the account's private Zearch notes and documents as evidence.

name: research

answer_type.description: verified: every paragraph passed Jev. excerpt: the selected source passage, because no draft could be supported.

evidence_span.description: Character offsets of the excerpt in the capture.

n.description: Citation number used in the answer, as [n].

status.description: pending, streaming, complete, error, interrupted or redacted.

title: Research with checked answers
